title: Hello ytproplus users
message: Hello i am Archimetrix ,I want to thank you all for using my extension. SO gratefull .I created this updates section to notify all users of ytproplus time to time about annoucements etc.  If you guys face any bugs or want a feature you can request or raise issue in github i will be happy to help you .

title: Update Regarding PIP Mode
message: The PIP Mode works automatically if you turn on those 2 browser flags but at the same time you may face problem with other websites videos if you dont want pip there . then dont turn on those flags and normally just use pipmode from the player check there is a pipmode button just click on it and it will float everywhere .

title: Update to version 7.1.9
message: Everyone, please update the extension to version 7.1.9 This version introduces a new Default Video Quality feature and includes fixes for GitHub authentication.Please check whether GitHub authentication is working properly. Once you verify it, the extension will be unlocked for you for a lifetime. However, if the banner is still showing after successful authentication, please create a GitHub issue and describe the problem in detail so it can be investigated.There is also a huge update to VIVIMUSIC Web! If you use YouTube Music, I highly recommend updating to the latest version of VIVIMUSIC Web. It includes a significantly enhanced user experience along with fixes for several minor issues.
